Windows Companion + mobile web controller

Your laptop. Wherever you are.

SARAS connects your phone to your own Windows computer. Install the Companion on your laptop, sign in on this website, and approve the pairing on the computer before using supported actions.

Open SARAS mobile controller →Download for Windows

The mobile controller is a web app. A paired Windows computer must be on, awake, online and running the Companion.

Start in three simple steps

  1. Install SARAS Companion on your Windows 10/11 PC.
  2. Open this website on your phone and sign in.
  3. Pair with a temporary code or QR, then approve it on the laptop.
How SARAS works

Your laptop stays in your control.

1. Windows Companion

The companion runs on your computer and performs supported local actions. It must remain open and connected for remote control.

2. Your mobile account

Sign in to see your account’s paired devices. New laptop connections require a short-lived pairing flow and approval on the laptop.

3. Visible device access

Choose supported permissions, review your connected devices, and remove a device from your account settings when you no longer want it connected.

Know before you connect: SARAS is in public preview. Available commands depend on the release and granted permissions. AI conversations may require your own provider key. Do not use the service for emergency actions or share your pairing code.
